content.text: In Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and currency collapse have crippled traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal, a new generation of digital creators has turned to cryptocurrency-based commerce to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software directly to their customers. These creators, like you, need infrastructure that can survive and thrive in the face of platform restrictions and economic uncertainty. That's where COREMERCH comes in – a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that designs, documents, and deploys fully operational online stores with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, all without relying on conventional payment platforms like Stripe.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure operates independently of traditional payment processors, using cryptocurrency-based payment processing through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. This allows you to collect payments directly from your customers without relying on platforms that may restrict or shut down your business at any time. Moreover, the infrastructure is fully scalable, allowing you to grow your business without worrying about platform limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to assemble the necessary tools and infrastructure, including a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting platform, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. You'll also need to sign up for a NOWPayments account and add their payment gateway to your stack. Fortunately, COREMERCH offers a range of pre-configured stacks and templates to help you get started quickly and easily.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments in your preferred cryptocurrency and set up automated delivery of your digital products through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You'll also need to configure your Supabase or Google Sheets database to store customer orders and set up automated email notifications to keep your customers informed about the status of their orders. With COREMERCH's pre-configured stacks and templates, this process is easier than ever.
With COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks, you can collect payments directly from your customers without relying on platforms that may restrict or shut down your business at any time.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves setting up a test account with NOWPayments, testing your payment processing and delivery pipeline, and then launching your sovereign digital commerce stack to the public. With COREMERCH's support and documentation, you'll be up and running in no time, processing payments and delivering digital products to your customers with confidence and ease.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is running smoothly, it's time to scale your business to meet the demands of growing customer base. This involves configuring your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales, optimizing your payment processing and delivery pipeline for maximum efficiency, and monitoring your performance to identify areas for improvement. With COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack that meets the needs of your growing business.
